## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 425 captures during March 2025. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity level provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes across the reporting period.

The reported activity should be read alongside the quality and grading measures below. Together, these measures describe the volume of work completed, the proportion of images requiring further attention, and the timeliness of the grading process.

## Image quality

A total of 21 captures were assessed as ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 4.9 of all captures reported for the month. The result identifies the images that could not be used for grading and should continue to inform routine quality monitoring.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

There were 113 referable results during March 2025. The median grading lag was 1 day. This measure indicates the typical interval between capture and completion of grading, while the referable total records the results requiring referral or further clinical consideration. These figures provide the monthly operational position for West Gate Eye Clinic.
